description: This file defines the 'BaseVoidHandler' class which implements the 'VoidHandler' interface for handling void operations on 'Voidable' entities in OpenMRS. It manages setting void status, reason, user, and date fields on objects.

classes.name: BaseVoidHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for managing void operations on 'Voidable' objects within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets void-related attributes (voided, void reason, voided by, date voided) on the provided 'Voidable' object based on input parameters, with logic to handle already voided objects.
